free_tier.stated: no free tier: Plus is USD 30 a user a month and includes USD 30 of monthly credits per user and USD 2 of free daily credits on login per user
free_tier.notes: the credits are spent per token at the model prices in notes (input, cache write, cache read and output), so the true metering is tokens priced in USD, which the metered_on vocabulary lacks; unused monthly credits roll over and expire after 65 days

per_object_cap.stated: 20 MB per chat attachment and 50 MB per ZIP upload on Plus, against 5 MB and 10 MB on Free

retention.stated: not applicable: the unit is credits, not stored bytes

egress.terms: not applicable: apps deploy to Vercel, whose own plan allowances apply to what is served

interface_detail: REST API at https://api.v0.dev with the v0 npm SDK (v0 in v2, v0-sdk in v1), authenticated by an API key made in the v0 settings; a remote MCP server at https://v0.app/api/mcp that signs in by OAuth, and AI SDK tools (@v0-sdk/ai-tools). Chats are created and continued by calls such as chats.create and messages.send, with async variants, so a generation can run with no browser. The docs list no command-line client (the /docs/cli page does not exist). Whether a Free account may mint an API key was not seen: the keys page answered a login wall
tooling: the user calls the v0 REST API or installs the npm package v0 (or the v1 package v0-sdk) in a program they run, or adds https://v0.app/api/mcp as a remote MCP server to an MCP-capable client; the apps v0 builds deploy to Vercel
chaining: Plus bills through Vercel (centralized billing on vercel.com) and adds a shared credit pool across the team; the apps it builds deploy to Vercel

limits.value: USD 30 of included monthly credits per user plus USD 2 of free daily credits on login per user; further credits are bought and shared across the team; unused monthly credits expire after 65 days

limits_note: capacity is a credit balance, not a message count: Plus has no daily message limit (the comparison table lists it as credit-based) and generation pauses when credits run out
binding_note: the monthly credit balance decides how much a Plus seat can generate; when it is used up, generation pauses until credits are added

identity_cost.detail: a Vercel account (email, Google, GitHub, Apple or ChatGPT sign-up), then a paid upgrade with centralized billing on vercel.com; the payment fields were not seen, so what the checkout asks for is unverified: behind a sign-up

reliability_note: not stated on the pages read: no outage, suspension or throttling event is recorded
confidence_note: price, credits and model prices are quoted from the first-party pricing pages read on 2026-11-02; the checkout steps are behind a sign-up and unverified. The pricing page shows a struck-through USD 90 beside the USD 30, whose meaning is not stated
